description: BLOCK until the human clicks 'more options / none of these' in the live panel (or timeoutSec elapses). Prefer font_lab_wait (unified) — it covers both picks AND requests in one call. This single-event variant is still useful when you specifically want to wait ONLY for a request. Returns { requested: true, request } — where request.brief is the mini-brief (feeling / departure / brand / note) and request.exclude lists families already shown. On a request: compose new directions, call font_lab_more_directions, then switch to font_lab_wait. Returns { requested: false, timedOut: true } on timeout — call again.

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the user's project root (any framework — Next.js, Vite, Astro, Remix, SvelteKit, TanStack, …).

timeoutSec.description: Max seconds to block (default 240). Re-call on timeout.

name: font_lab_wait_for_request
